title: Technology Sector Update for 11/23/2018: TWLO,UTX,ABIL
text:

Technology stocks ended lower, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing 0.9% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was little changed.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Twilio ( TWLO ) jumped 5% on Friday after the cloud communications company late Wednesday said it received an early termination notice this week for the waiting period required under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act for its proposed acquisition of SendGrid.
In other sector news:
(+) United Technologies ( UTX ) climbed almost 3% on Friday after receiving approval for its proposed acquisition of Rockwell Collins ( COL ) from Chinese regulators.
(-) Ability ( ABIL ) plunged 46% after the Israeli software firm priced a $10 million public offering of 3 million units at $3.25 each.
